NOTE: (Kyiv Post non-approved; corroboration only.) Tue 21 Jul: Ukraine & Russia dramatically intensified attacks on civilian cargo ships in Black Sea since Saturday, ending a tacit agreement that neutral vessels would not be systematically targeted with anti-ship attacks. Ukraine drone swarms hit 3 oil tankers over Sun-Mon at Russia's KTK/CPC terminal (26km N of Novorossiysk) loading Kazakh crude. Russia's Sun salvo of 3 Kh-59/Kh-69 anti-ship cruise missiles hit grain bulk carrier Golden Leo off Odesa, killing 10 (deadliest attack on a merchant crew of the war). For approved sourcing on the Ukrainian side use Reuters (Kernel/Chornomorsk coverage) + Bloomberg (Kazakhstan CPC). Russian MoD (Tue) said air defences downed 209 Ukrainian drones overnight across Belgorod/Bryansk/Voronezh/Kaluga/Kursk/Rostov/Ryazan/Moscow region + Krasnodar/Stavropol; claimed strikes on two bulk carriers + a dry cargo ship delivering supplies to Chornomorsk. Ukraine said Russia launched 58 drones overnight; 46 downed, 8 hit 7 locations.
